citation.authors: Bernardi LA, Ghant MS, Andrade C, Recht H et al

record.population: 44 premenopausal African American women, a pilot
record.finding: Iron deficiency was present in 68.2% and anaemia in 18.2%. Women who reported heavy or very heavy periods had lower haemoglobin, haematocrit and ferritin and more anaemia symptoms. Of those reporting heavy periods, 35% were anaemic. The authors recommend evaluation for iron deficiency and anaemia whenever African American women report heavy bleeding.
